title: Spicy Beef Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy taco recipe using ground beef, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the taco seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the canned diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Warm the tacos by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef and onion mixture onto a taco and topping with cheese, salsa, avocado or guacamole, and sour cream.
